caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a tall grandfather clock, centered on a plain, off-white background. The clock is rendered in shades of brown, suggesting a wooden construction, with areas of darker and lighter browns to indicate shadow and grain. The clock has a rectangular base that expands outward just above four short, curved legs. The central section consists of a tall, narrow door with a rectangular border, positioned vertically. Above the door is a section with additional ornate woodworking details leading up to the clock's face. The clock face itself is an arch-topped rectangle, primarily gold or brass in color, and features black Roman numerals, black clock hands, and additional ornate black markings. The face is encased in a wooden frame and flanked by pillars. At the very top are three decorative, gold-tipped finials, spaced evenly, with one at the center and one on each end. The background contains no other objects or details, drawing full attention to the grandfather clock.
title: Miniature Tall Clock
